llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed image-generation wrapper for the dLazy CLI, with expected use of an API key, cloud calls, and user-selected file uploads.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses that prompts and parameters are sent to `api.dlazy.com`, user-provided local media paths are uploaded to `files.dlazy.com`, and result URLs are hosted there; this is proportionate for a cloud image-generation tool.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned npm package, `@dlazy/cli@1.2.3`, with an npx alternative and disclosed source, homepage, npm package, and endpoints.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger phrases include generic image-generation terms, so agents should invoke it only when the user clearly wants this dLazy/Nano Banana image workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Authentication persists a dLazy API key in `~/.dlazy/config.json` or accepts `DLAZY_API_KEY`; this is disclosed, scoped to the service, and revocable from the dashboard.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to generate and edit images with Nano Banana 2.0, and the instructions consistently invoke `dlazy banana2` for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using the dLazy service: prompts and selected input files are sent to dLazy, outputs are hosted by dLazy, and login stores a dLazy API key locally. Prefer the pinned `npx @dlazy/cli@1.2.3` path if you do not want a long-lived global CLI install, and invoke the skill only for intentional dLazy/Nano Banana image tasks.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The referenced bilingual file was present locally and inspected, so the partial-inspection concern was not validated.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad image-related triggers are purpose-aligned but could activate too readily; this supports user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
[P9] expected: The flagged whitespace appears to be markdown table spacing; full inspection found no hidden instructions below or beyond the visible content.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese localized error-handling instruction is limited to telling users about insufficient credits or missing API keys and does not expand authority.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied SARIF contained no T01-T09 security findings.
